2607.21402.title: MSBraM: A Multi-scale Self-supervised Brain Foundation Model for Hierarchical EEG Dynamics Learning
2607.21402.paper_summary: Self-supervised foundation models have recently shown strong potential for electroencephalogram (EEG)-based analysis. However, existing approaches struggle to capture the inherently multi-scale temporal structure of EEG signals, where local neural patterns and long-range dependencies jointly encode task-relevant information. This limitation hampers cross-scale representation learning and generalization across diverse downstream tasks. To address this challenge, we propose MSBraM, a Multi-Scale self-supervised Brain foundation Model designed to learn hierarchical EEG representations. MSBraM follows a two-stage pretraining framework. First, a multi-scale neural tokenizer discretizes raw EEG signals into semantic codes at different temporal resolutions via vector-quantized reconstruction. Second, the model is pretrained to predict masked codes using a curriculum multi-scale masking strategy, progressively integrating fine-grained local patterns with global temporal context. We pretrain MSBraM on over 2,400 hours of EEG data and evaluate it across 10 downstream tasks on 12 public datasets. Extensive experiments show that MSBraM achieves superior performance on other state-of-the-art pretrained models, demonstrating strong generalization and transferability. These results indicate that explicitly modeling multi-scale temporal dynamics is critical for effective EEG foundation models.
2607.21402.paper_summary_zh: 自我監督的基礎模型最近在基於腦電圖（EEG）的分析中顯示出強大的潛力。<lb/>然而，現有的方法難以捕捉EEG信號固有的多尺度時間結構，其中局部神經模式和長距離依賴共同編碼與任務相關的信息。<lb/>這一限制妨礙了跨尺度表示學習和在多樣化下游任務中的泛化。<lb/>為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了MSBraM，一種多尺度自我監督的腦基礎模型，旨在學習層次化的EEG表示。<lb/>MSBraM遵循兩階段的預訓練框架。<lb/>首先，多尺度神經標記器將原始EEG信號在不同時間解析度下離散化為語義代碼，通過向量量化重建。<lb/>其次，該模型預訓練以使用課程多尺度掩蔽策略預測被掩蔽的代碼，逐步整合細粒度的局部模式與全局時間上下文。<lb/>我們在超過2400小時的EEG數據上預訓練MSBraM，並在12個公共數據集上的10個下游任務中進行評估。<lb/>廣泛的實驗表明，MSBraM在其他最先進的預訓練模型上達到了優越的性能，顯示出強大的泛化和可轉移性。<lb/>這些結果表明，明確建模多尺度時間動態對於有效的EEG基礎模型至關重要。
